ipeds.title: IPEDS Admissions survey, fall 2024 entering class (ADM2024) via College Navigator

ipeds_portal.title: IPEDS admissions counts and fall 2024 enrollment (nonresident undergraduates) via Urban Institute Education Data Portal

stats.notes: Figures from IPEDS, the US government's college data (fall 2024 entering class): applicants, admits and enrollees from the Education Data Portal; test submission rates and percentiles from College Navigator. Suffolk does not publish a Common Data Set (its Institutional Research page lists a Factbook on the staff intranet only), so GPA, residency splits and international applicant counts are not available. SAT/ACT percentiles cover the 12% (115) / 2% (19) of enrollees who submitted scores. Undergraduate enrollment and the nonresident count (518, about 12%) are IPEDS fall 2024 undergraduate headcounts.
